changelog: Nothing an agent writes leaves without a preview you approved, and the line you send a friend to bring them in now names you.
features: Every message an agent sends for you goes through a preview first. A request to send without one opens the preview and sends nothing
The line /vibe gives you to bring someone in now carries your handle, so your first message reaches them while they work instead of waiting for their next session
Before sign-in, asking to message someone leads to sign-in and then a preview
